classification: frozen exploratory follow-up pilot plan; recorded before scored model runs

per_run_outcomes.primary: Count of 3 fixed order-detail acceptance tests passed (0-3).
per_run_outcomes.regression: Count of 11 fixed cancellation-hardening and characterization tests passed (0-11).
per_run_outcomes.combined: Count across all 14 fixed tests (0-14), plus all-tests-passed indicator.
per_run_outcomes.review: Record findings separately; same provider/model is not independent review.

evaluation_procedure: Generate proposals with test execution deferred from the API-enabled process. Evaluate each disposable proposal against the exact pinned target tests, restored from revision 94b6faa. Remove API credential and model variables from test subprocesses. For review-profile runs, send the saved diff and verification record to the separate review command; it executes no target code.
failure_policy: Record API errors, invalid JSON, timeouts, and test failures as observed; do not silently retry or replace attempts.
interpretation: Exploratory single-task follow-up case study with three repetitions per profile; not powered for broad causal claims. Report that the target already includes a human-authored cancellation feature and hardening tests.
excluded_runs: Original cancellation cohort and its reviews; distinct task/revision and cohort.
privacy_and_scope: Only independently created synthetic repository content and the synthetic order-detail task are sent. No employer material is included. Requests set store=false. Both repositories remain private during this work.
